parameters.query:
SELECT
  m.id                        AS membership_id,
  m.plan_name,
  m.policy_template,
  m.monthly_rate,
  m.status,
  m.start_date::text          AS start_date,
  m.end_date::text            AS end_date,
  m.notice_period_days,
  m.notes,
  m.created_at,
  rr.id                       AS rule_id,
  rr.room_id,
  r.name                      AS room_name,
  rr.day_of_week,
  rr.start_time::text         AS start_time,
  rr.end_time::text           AS end_time,
  rr.rate_per_session,
  rr.active                   AS rule_active
FROM bookings.memberships m
LEFT JOIN bookings.recurring_rules rr
  ON rr.membership_id = m.id AND rr.active = TRUE
LEFT JOIN bookings.rooms r
  ON r.id = rr.room_id
WHERE m.tenant_id   = $1
  AND m.customer_id = $2::uuid
  AND m.status      = 'active'
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, rr.day_of_week ASC;
